what_happened.line: The Agricultural Commission met remotely and took no votes except to adjourn; minutes were not ready, so none were approved.
Members discussed a flyer or brochure to promote the commission and local farms, and agreed to send ideas and drafts to the chair to distribute before meetings.
Members asked whether talking in pairs about the flyer would violate open meeting law, and the question was left without a resolution.
The chair will try to ask town counsel at office hours what the commission may do on social media for a page promoting farms.
The next meeting was set for November 19, with a reminder email to go out beforehand.
